five_actual_task_quote_bindings_logicall.statement: For Banach spaces E and Z, a bounded Fredholm operator T:E→Z remains Fredholm with the same index after addition of any compact operator K:E→Z. Fredholm index is locally constant in the operator norm topology. If R is bounded on a Banach space and ‖R‖<1, then I−R has the inverse Σ_{j≥0}R^j.
five_actual_task_quote_bindings_logicall.quote: Known background: supporting sets are nonempty, convex, weakly compact and absolutely continuous.

five_actual_task_quote_bindings_logicall.statement: For 1<p<∞, smooth functions are dense in W^{2,p} on compact smooth manifolds without boundary and on smooth bounded Euclidean domains. Smooth bounded domains admit bounded W^{2,p} extension operators. In real dimension m, W^{2,p} embeds continuously into C^{1,α} when p>m and 0<α≤1−m/p, and its inclusion into L^p is compact on these compact manifolds and bounded domains.
five_actual_task_quote_bindings_logicall.quote: Their densities have uniform L^p bounds on bounded sets of F for 1<p<n/(n-1), and at the endpoint if lower mass is positive.

five_actual_task_quote_bindings_logicall.statement: For locally bounded plurisubharmonic functions v_1,…,v_k on Ω⊂C^n, k≤n, the Bedford–Taylor currents dd^c v_1∧…∧dd^c v_k are defined recursively by distributional dd^c, are symmetric and multilinear, and converge weakly when each v_i is approached by a pointwise decreasing sequence of locally bounded psh functions with locally bounded psh limit.
five_actual_task_quote_bindings_logicall.quote: For real continuous F, c_0(F)>0 is the unique normalization scalar such that a bounded omega-psh solution u satisfies (omega+dd^c u)^n=c_0(F) exp(F) dV.

five_actual_task_quote_bindings_logicall.statement: For a smooth positive Hermitian metric κ on a connected compact complex manifold Y of complex dimension k≥2, the formal adjoint of L_κ=tr_κ(dd^c) has a one-dimensional smooth kernel generated by an everywhere strictly positive function. Consequently there is a unique smooth positive probability ν_κ satisfying ∫_Y L_κh dν_κ=0 for every smooth real h. No parity condition on the first Betti number is required.
five_actual_task_quote_bindings_logicall.quote: In dimension n>=2 supporting probabilities are normalized determinant-weighted measures of exact maximizing positive dd^c-closed (n-1,n-1) currents T with integral_X omega wedge T=1.

five_actual_task_quote_bindings_logicall.statement: A smooth elliptic differential operator P of order r on a compact smooth manifold without boundary is Fredholm from H^{s+r} to H^s for every real s. Its distributional solutions are smooth wherever their right-hand sides are smooth, and local smooth-coefficient elliptic regularity also holds in L^p Sobolev spaces for 1<p<∞.
five_actual_task_quote_bindings_logicall.quote: Resolve the full every-continuous-density singleton question by complete proof, or give a compact Hermitian example with a real continuous F and two demonstrably distinct probabilities satisfying the defining supporting inequality for all continuous G.
